articles.title: Does Raised Earnings Guidance Change The Bull Case For NSK Stock (TSE:6471)?
articles.summary: NSK Ltd. reported half year results for the period to September 30, 2026, with sales of ¥520,351 million and net income of ¥18,838 million, and also released corresponding earnings call materials in late October. The group raised its March 2027 full year guidance, citing stronger than expected Industrial Machinery demand linked to AI related capital spending and a weaker yen that supported reported sales and profit metrics.
